description: The one signed update channel for the Eliza Pixel 10a (stallion) Android 17 product. The signing job refuses while a field here is UNSET: the OTA package certificate (releasekey x509, installed as otacerts by sign_target_files_apks -o) and the AVB public key must match the runtime key directory. The update authority and release owner are a release decision recorded here before the first release. No key material, URL credential or recovery code belongs here. Drill results are recorded from executed drills, never by software.
